note: Re-judged at HEAD against RFC 4271 Section 6.3 ("If the NEXT_HOP attribute is semantically incorrect, the error SHOULD be logged, and the route SHOULD be ignored."). TestRFC4271SemanticallyIncorrectNextHopIsLoggedAtTheDefaultLevel (WARN) and TestRFC4271SemanticallyIncorrectNextHopIsLoggedAndIgnored (Debug) drive a live one-hop eBGP Session through session_next_hop.go (invalidReceiveNextHop / logIgnoredNextHopRoute): positive tests both criterion (a) receiving speaker's own address and criterion (b) off-subnet NEXT_HOP, asserting route withdrawal/empty NLRI and exact WARN/Debug log fields; negative tests an on-subnet NEXT_HOP delivered with no error log. TestRFC4271SelfNextHopRouteIsNotInstalled additionally proves the RIB decision process excludes self-next-hop routes while installing a valid control.
